stories.summary: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong met Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang separately on Sunday, ahead of today's 22nd Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation meeting, which Gan will co-chair with Ding. Both leaders highlighted the JCBC as the key platform for turning shared ambitions into concrete projects, capping back-to-back visits after Wong's four-day trip to China.
stories.title: Wong and Gan meet Ding Xuexiang, affirm JCBC's key role in Singapore-China ties
stories.why: Today's JCBC is the centrepiece of the year's Singapore-China agenda, and the back-to-back visits show both sides pushing the relationship forward.

stories.summary: Stroke episodes rose from 6,720 to 10,664 between 2013 and 2023, according to the National Registry of Diseases Office's Singapore Stroke Registry 2023 report. The age-standardised rate for 15- to 29-year-olds almost doubled, from 3.9 to 7.4 per 100,000, and rose about 40% for 30- to 39-year-olds, driven by poor diet, sedentary lifestyles and rising rates of hypertension, diabetes and high cholesterol.
stories.title: Stroke cases rise among young adults in Singapore
stories.why: Strokes are hitting younger Singaporeans at sharply higher rates, with lifelong consequences for people in their prime working years.

stories.summary: Singapore signed three air services agreements — upgraded deals with Brazil and Türkiye, and a first with El Salvador — plus four aviation training agreements with ICAO, Colombia, Mozambique and the Kyrgyz Republic, concluded on 18–19 November at the Worldwide Air Transport Conference in Montreal, the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore said. The Türkiye deal lifts capacity and aircraft-type restrictions, and the Brazil deal further liberalises cargo.
stories.title: Singapore signs seven agreements to strengthen air hub
stories.why: It widens Singapore's air connectivity and aviation-training reach, reinforcing Changi's position as a regional hub.

stories.summary: Shenzhen-listed video-conferencing firm Yealink has opened a Singapore office as a base to target customers in India and South-east Asia.
stories.title: Shenzhen-listed Yealink's Singapore office targets India, South-east Asian markets
stories.why: Another Chinese tech firm is using Singapore as its regional hub — a small but steady signal of the city-state's pull as a launchpad into the region.

stories.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed “perplexity” — how well an AI predicts the next token — as a shared yardstick for measuring AI progress, and suggested frontier labs agree on common limits they would not cross until safety-monitoring milestones are met. CEO Sam Altman backed the idea.
stories.title: OpenAI's chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development
stories.why: It is the first time OpenAI has publicly floated a concrete, measurable framework for capping frontier AI development — a possible basis for industry-wide safety coordination.

stories.summary: Asian markets face more volatility after the S&P 500 entered a technical correction and the Nasdaq 100 suffered its worst week since March 2020, with the VIX at its highest since April 2025. China has cut margin requirements, Taiwan has curbed short-selling and South Korea has readied a stabilisation fund in response.
stories.title: Asia braces for more volatility after US selloff
stories.why: The US selloff is spilling into Asia, and regional regulators are already stepping in to steady markets.

stories.summary: The dollar eased off its highest level in more than a year and a half in early Asian trade as confidence recovered after last week's selloff. Traders pared bets on aggressive Fed hikes: futures now price an 88.6% chance of a 25-basis-point hike at the December 8–9 meeting, with a 50-point move fully priced out. The dollar index was flat at 103.80, and bitcoin traded around $60,795.
stories.title: Dollar edges off 19-month high after market rout; yen softens
stories.why: Markets have stopped pricing an aggressive Fed response to the selloff — the December hike is now expected to be a modest 25 basis points.

stories.summary: New Zealand's NZX50 fell 1.08% to 13,955 as the US market rout flowed through to the region.
stories.title: NZ shares fall 1% as overseas markets plunge
stories.why: A concrete regional marker of how far the US selloff is spreading.

stories.summary: Iran's parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said the current state of “neither war nor peace” with the United States cannot continue and called for “sustainable deterrence”. The statement was made on Sunday; the article is dated today.
stories.title: Iran warns US 'neither war nor peace' cannot continue
stories.why: It signals Tehran is pressing for a resolution — a deal or a posture that deters — rather than indefinite limbo with Washington.

stories.summary: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones struck the Russian corvette Merkury at the Benghazi naval base in Libya, capsizing and sinking it; a second vessel, Ascalon, was also hit, and more than 20 drone boats were intercepted on Sunday evening.
stories.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base
stories.why: It shows Ukraine's maritime drone campaign reaching the Mediterranean and hitting Russian naval assets far from the Black Sea.

stories.summary: A Russian rescue vessel has begun towing the drone-hit cargo ship Sparta II out of Finnish waters after two days of firefighting. The vessel, bound for Kaliningrad and operated by a company linked to Russia's Defence Ministry, was struck by two drones on Saturday in the Gulf of Finland — an attack Finland assesses was likely carried out by Ukraine. All 16 crew were evacuated, one slightly injured.
stories.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
stories.why: It extends the campaign against Russian military logistics into the Baltic, and the narrow Gulf of Finland remains at risk of further incidents.

stories.summary: Germany has tested kamikaze drones fitted with AI targeting technology in Lithuania, as European forces trial a new generation of loitering munitions.
stories.title: Germany tests kamikaze drones and AI targeting technology in Lithuania
stories.why: AI-guided loitering munitions are moving from concept to live trials in Europe — a concrete step toward more autonomous strike weapons.

tldr: Singapore: Wong and Gan meet China's Ding Xuexiang ahead of today's JCBC meeting.
Technology: OpenAI's chief scientist proposes perplexity as a shared yardstick to limit AI development.
Finance: Asia braces for more volatility after the US selloff.
Defence: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones sink a Russian corvette at Benghazi.
